scripts.build:chrome: BROWSER=chrome tsc && BROWSER=chrome vite build --outDir dist-chrome
scripts.package: npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && mkdir -p packages && (cd dist && zip -r -FS ../packages/lazarus-form-recovery-firefox.zip . -x '*.map') && cp packages/lazarus-form-recovery-firefox.zip packages/lazarus-form-recovery-firefox.xpi
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && mkdir -p packages && (cd dist-chrome && zip -r -FS ../packages/lazarus-form-recovery-chrome.zip . -x '*.map')
scripts.lint: npm run lint:firefox && npm run lint:chrome
